name: Liqueur
description: A sweetened spirit flavoured with fruit, herbs, nuts, spices or other botanicals. Used as a modifier in cocktails or served as a digestif.

name: Orange Liqueur
description: A sweetened orange peel spirit covering triple sec and curacao styles. Essential in the Margarita, Sidecar, Cosmopolitan and Mai Tai.

name: Triple Sec
description: A clear, dryish orange liqueur made from sweet and bitter orange peel in neutral spirit. The workhorse orange modifier for Margaritas and sours.

name: Curaçao
description: An orange liqueur originally tied to Laraha orange peel from Curacao. Includes clear, orange and blue bottlings used in tiki and classic drinks.

name: Maraschino Liqueur
description: A clear liqueur distilled from marasca cherries, including pits and leaves. Dry cherry, almond and floral notes for the Aviation, Last Word and Hemingway Daiquiri.

name: Elderflower Liqueur
description: A pale floral liqueur made from elderflower blossoms with citrus and sugar. Soft pear and honeysuckle flavour used in spritzes and gin drinks.

name: Coffee Liqueur
description: A sweetened spirit flavoured with coffee, often on a rum or neutral spirit base. The backbone of the Espresso Martini, White Russian and Black Russian.

name: Crème de Cacao
description: A sweet chocolate liqueur from cacao beans, sold clear (white) or brown (dark). Used in the Brandy Alexander, Grasshopper and dessert cocktails.

name: Crème de Menthe
description: A sweet mint liqueur, green or clear (white). Peppermint forward, used in the Grasshopper, Stinger and as a mint accent in stirred drinks.

name: Crème de Cassis
description: A dark blackcurrant liqueur from Burgundy and elsewhere. Rich berry sweetness for a Kir, Kir Royale or as a fruit modifier.

name: Crème de Violette
description: A violet flower liqueur, usually purple, with perfume-like floral sweetness. Essential in the Aviation and other floral classics.

name: Crème de Mûre
description: A sweet blackberry liqueur in the creme style. Deep berry flavour for brambles, spritzes and as a fruit sweetener in sours.

name: Apricot Liqueur
description: A sweet apricot fruit liqueur, sometimes labelled apricot brandy. Soft stone fruit for the Party, Havana and many modern stirred drinks.

name: Peach Liqueur
description: A sweet peach flavoured liqueur or schnapps. Juicy stone fruit used in the Fuzzy Navel, Sex on the Beach and peach sours.

name: Banana Liqueur
description: A sweet banana flavoured liqueur, yellow or clear. Ripe banana aroma for tiki drinks, dessert cocktails and banana Daiquiri style serves.

name: Amaretto
description: An Italian almond style liqueur, often from apricot kernels rather than almonds. Sweet marzipan flavour for the Amaretto Sour and Godfather.

name: Falernum
description: A sweet Caribbean spice liqueur or syrup with lime, almond and clove. Essential in tiki drinks such as the Zombie and Corn n Oil.

name: Allspice Dram
description: A Jamaican style rum based liqueur flavoured with allspice berries (pimento). Warm baking spice for tiki drinks and stirred whiskey cocktails.

name: Ginger Liqueur
description: A sweet liqueur flavoured with fresh ginger root, often with citrus or cognac. Spicy warmth for mule style drinks, highballs and whiskey cocktails.

name: Cherry Liqueur
description: A sweet cherry flavoured liqueur, red and fruity. Used in the Singapore Sling, Blood and Sand and as a general cherry modifier.

name: Raspberry Liqueur
description: A sweet raspberry or black raspberry liqueur. Bright berry flavour for French Martinis, Champagne cocktails and dessert drinks.

name: Melon Liqueur
description: A bright green honeydew melon liqueur. Sweet and lightly grassy, used in the Midori Sour, Japanese Slipper and tropical mixed drinks.

name: Limoncello
description: An Italian lemon peel liqueur, usually from southern Italy, bright yellow and sweet. Served ice cold as a digestif or in lemon cocktails.

name: Cream Liqueur
description: A dairy cream based liqueur, often with whiskey, rum or other spirit. Soft, sweet and used in Irish Coffee toppers and dessert drinks.

name: Herbal Liqueur
description: A catch all for sweetened herbal and monastic style liqueurs made with botanicals. Includes Chartreuse style and other complex herb blends.

name: Chile Liqueur
description: A spirit based liqueur flavoured with chile peppers such as ancho or green chile. Warm spice and fruit for Margaritas and stirred agave drinks.

name: Corn Liqueur
description: A sweet liqueur made from corn, often Mexican elote style with roasted corn flavour. Soft cereal sweetness for Margaritas and modern cocktails.

name: Passion Fruit Liqueur
description: A bright, tropical liqueur flavoured with passion fruit. Tangy and aromatic for Pornstar Martini style drinks and tiki.

name: Coconut Liqueur
description: A sweet coconut flavoured liqueur, often rum based. Soft tropical coconut for Pinacolada style drinks and beach cocktails.

name: Walnut Liqueur
description: A dark liqueur made from green walnuts, Italian nocino style. Bitter chocolate and spice notes for stirred drinks and digestifs.

name: Hazelnut Liqueur
description: A sweet hazelnut flavoured liqueur. Toasted nut and vanilla character for coffee drinks, dessert cocktails and hazelnut sours.

name: Umeshu
description: A Japanese plum liqueur made by steeping ume fruit in spirit with sugar. Soft apricot and almond notes, drunk neat, on ice or with soda.

name: Ume Liqueur
description: A plum or ume fruit liqueur in the Japanese umeshu style. Sweet stone fruit with a light tart edge.

name: Bergamot Liqueur
description: A citrus liqueur flavoured with bergamot orange peel. Floral, bitter orange tea character used in spritzes and stirred drinks.

name: Blood Orange Liqueur
description: An orange liqueur made with blood orange peel or fruit. Deeper, berry tinged citrus for Margaritas and sparkling serves.

name: Pomegranate Liqueur
description: A sweet tart liqueur flavoured with pomegranate. Red fruit and light astringency for Margaritas, spritzes and fruit cocktails.

name: Scotch Liqueur
description: A honeyed liqueur based on Scotch whisky with herbs and spices. Sweet malt and heather honey for Rusty Nails and after dinner pours.

name: Advocaat
description: A Dutch egg yolk and brandy liqueur, thick and custard yellow. Used in the Snowball with lemonade and as a dessert pour.

name: Crème de Noyaux
description: A pink or clear almond style liqueur from apricot or peach kernels. Bitter almond flavour for the Pink Squirrel and classic dessert drinks.

name: Yuzu Liqueur
description: A Japanese citrus liqueur made with yuzu fruit. Bright, aromatic lemon lime grapefruit character for highballs and citrus cocktails.

name: Mastiha Liqueur
description: A Greek liqueur flavoured with mastic resin from Chios. Piney, sweet and slightly resinous, served chilled or in Mediterranean cocktails.

name: Kümmel
description: A clear caraway and cumin seed liqueur from northern Europe. Dry, spicy and slightly sweet, traditionally a digestif.

name: Schnapps
description: In bar use, a sweet fruit flavoured spirit such as peach, apple or peppermint schnapps. Sweeter and lower proof than true German schnaps.

name: Chocolate Liqueur
description: A sweet liqueur flavoured with chocolate or cacao, sometimes with cream. Used in dessert cocktails and as a chocolate modifier.

name: Honey Liqueur
description: A sweet liqueur flavoured with honey, sometimes on a whiskey or vodka base. Soft floral sweetness for bees knees style drinks and hot toddies.

name: Muscat Liqueur
description: A grapey liqueur based on Muscat wine or grapes, often with orange blossom. Soft floral fruit for aperitif spritzes.

name: Citrus Liqueur
description: A broad class of sweetened citrus peel liqueurs beyond straight orange or lemon. Includes blends of lemon, orange and other peels.

name: Peach Aperitif
description: A lightly fortified peach aperitif wine style drink, lower in sugar than peach schnapps. Soft peach for spritzes and low ABV cocktails.

name: Apricot Brandy
description: A traditional label for apricot liqueur, not always a true brandy distillate. Soft apricot used in many classic cocktail recipes.

name: Cointreau
description: A clear French triple sec from Angers, made with sweet and bitter orange peel. Bright, clean orange at cocktail strength, the default for Margaritas and Sidecars.

name: Cointreau Noir
description: Cointreau blended with Remy Martin cognac for a darker, richer orange liqueur. More weight than clear Cointreau, used in stirred and dessert drinks.

name: Grand Marnier Cordon Rouge
description: A cognac based orange liqueur from France with bitter orange essence. Richer and oak tinged compared with triple sec, for sipping or Cadillac Margaritas.

name: Pierre Ferrand Dry Curaçao
description: A brandy based dry curacao made with Maison Ferrand to a 19th century style. Bitter orange, vanilla and spice, a bartender favourite for Mai Tais.

name: Combier Liqueur d'Orange
description: Often cited as the original triple sec, distilled in Saumur since 1834 with orange peels. Clear, fragrant orange close to Cointreau in style.

name: Giffard Curaçao Triple Sec
description: A clear orange triple sec from Giffard in the Loire. Clean sweet bitter orange for Margaritas and other citrus cocktails.

name: Bols Blue Curaçao
description: A vivid blue orange curacao from the Dutch house of Bols. Sweet orange flavour used mainly for colour in Blue Lagoons and tiki drinks.

name: De Kuyper Blue Curaçao
description: A widely stocked blue orange curacao from De Kuyper. Sweet citrus and bright colour for high volume mixed drinks.

name: Marie Brizard Orange Curaçao
description: An orange curacao from the Bordeaux liqueur house Marie Brizard. Soft orange peel sweetness for classics and dessert drinks.

name: Solerno Blood Orange Liqueur
description: A Sicilian blood orange liqueur in a distinctive faceted bottle. Bright citrus with a red fruit edge for Margaritas and sparkling cocktails.

name: Clément Créole Shrubb
description: A Martinique orange liqueur based on agricole rum with creole spices and bitter orange. Used in rum punches and as a curacao alternative.

name: Senior Curaçao of Curaçao
description: Orange liqueur made on the island of Curacao from Laraha citrus peel. Available clear, orange and blue; the authentic island style curacao.

name: Patrón Citrónge Orange
description: An orange liqueur from Patron, made with sweet and sour orange peels. Soft and citrusy, aimed at Margaritas and tequila cocktails.

name: Luxardo Triplum Triple Sec
description: Luxardo's triple sec from bitter orange, sweet orange and mandarin. Clear and aromatic, a premium alternative to Cointreau.

name: Merlet Trois Citrus
description: A French citrus liqueur blending sweet orange, bitter orange and lemon peels. Bright mixed citrus for sours and sparkling drinks.

name: Marionette Bitter Curacao
description: An Australian bitter orange curacao from Marionette. Drier orange peel character for classic and modern cocktails.

name: Luxardo Maraschino Originale
description: The standard bar maraschino from Torreglia, Italy, distilled from marasca cherries. Clear, nutty and dry cherry, used in the Last Word and Aviation.

name: Green Chartreuse
description: The original Chartreuse from the Carthusian monks in Voiron, with 130 herbs. Intense, herbal and high proof, for the Last Word and Bijou.

name: Yellow Chartreuse
description: The milder, sweeter Chartreuse style, coloured yellow and bottled lower than the green. Honeyed herbs for the Alaska, Widow's Kiss and sipping.

name: Bénédictine D.O.M.
description: A French herbal liqueur from Fecamp, made with 27 plants and spices. Honeyed, spicy and monastic in style, for the Bobby Burns and Singapore Sling.

name: B&B Bénédictine and Brandy
description: Benedictine cut with brandy for a drier, lighter pour than straight DOM. Soft herbs and cognac warmth, often drunk on the rocks.
image_query: B and B Benedictine and Brandy bottle

name: Strega
description: An Italian saffron yellow herbal liqueur from Benevento since 1860. Mint, fennel and spice over a sweet base, used neat or in modern classics.

name: Galliano L'Autentico
description: Tall bottle Italian herbal liqueur with strong vanilla, anise and Mediterranean herbs. The classic pour for a Harvey Wallbanger and many tiki builds.

name: Dolin Génépy le Chamois
description: An alpine genepi liqueur from Dolin in Chambery. Lightly sweet mountain wormwood herbs, softer than Chartreuse, for apres ski and stirred drinks.

name: Drambuie
description: A Scotch whisky liqueur with heather honey, herbs and spices. Sweet malt and honey for the Rusty Nail and as a whiskey modifier.

name: Licor 43
description: A Spanish liqueur with 43 ingredients, led by vanilla and citrus. Sweet and fragrant, popular in coffee drinks and simple mixed serves.

name: Jägermeister
description: A German herbal digestif with 56 botanicals, dark and bittersweet. Drunk ice cold as a shot or in Jagerbombs and modern cocktails.

name: Becherovka
description: A Czech herbal liqueur from Karlovy Vary with cinnamon and clove character. Bitter sweet and spicy, served chilled or with tonic.

name: Gilka Kaiser-Kümmel
description: A classic Berlin kummel with caraway and cumin seed. Clear, dry and spicy, the traditional northern European digestif style.

name: St-Germain Elderflower Liqueur
description: French elderflower liqueur from hand picked blossoms, pale gold and lightly sweet. Floral pear notes for spritzes, Champagne cocktails and gin drinks.

name: Marionette Elderflower Liqueur
description: An Australian elderflower liqueur from Marionette. Fresh floral character used as a local alternative to St-Germain.

name: St. Elder Elderflower Liqueur
description: An American elderflower liqueur widely stocked as a value alternative to St-Germain. Soft floral sweetness for spritzes and gin cocktails.

name: Italicus Rosolio di Bergamotto
description: An Italian bergamot rosolio with botanicals including chamomile and rose. Citrus floral aperitif character for spritzes and stirred drinks.

name: Kahlúa
description: Mexican coffee liqueur made with rum, sugar and arabica coffee. Sweet coffee and vanilla for White Russians, Espresso Martinis and dessert drinks.

name: Mr Black Cold Brew Coffee Liqueur
match: Mr Black Cold Brew Coffee Liqueur
description: Australian cold brew coffee liqueur with a drier, roast led profile. Higher coffee intensity than old school coffee liqueurs, built for Espresso Martinis.
image_query: Mr Black cold brew coffee liqueur bottle

name: Tia Maria
description: Jamaican coffee liqueur with rum, coffee and vanilla. Lighter and a little drier than Kahlua, used in coffee cocktails and Espresso Martinis.

name: Borghetti Espresso Liqueur
description: Italian espresso coffee liqueur from Bologna, made with real espresso. Dark roast bitterness for coffee cocktails and dessert serves.

name: Baileys Irish Cream
description: Irish whiskey blended with cream and cocoa, the global standard cream liqueur. Soft chocolate and dairy for Irish Coffee, mudslides and over ice.

name: Amarula Cream Liqueur
description: South African cream liqueur made with marula fruit spirit. Soft caramel and tropical fruit over cream, usually served on ice.

name: RumChata
description: An American cream liqueur of rum, dairy and horchata spices (cinnamon, vanilla, rice). Sweet and milky for shots and dessert cocktails.

name: Carolans Irish Cream
description: Irish cream liqueur sweetened with honey as well as cream and whiskey. Softer and a touch lighter than Baileys, for coffee and dessert drinks.

name: Disaronno Originale
description: The best known amaretto, from Saronno, Italy, with apricot kernel flavour. Sweet marzipan character for Amaretto Sours and Godfathers.

name: Lazzaroni Amaretto
description: Amaretto from the Lazzaroni family, infused with their amaretti biscuits. Toasted almond and apricot kernel sweetness for classic amaretto drinks.

name: Frangelico
description: Italian hazelnut liqueur in a friar shaped bottle, with toasted hazelnut, vanilla and cocoa. Used in coffee drinks and dessert cocktails.

name: Nux Alpina Walnut Liqueur
description: Austrian green walnut liqueur from Purkhart. Dark, bittersweet walnut and spice for stirred drinks and as a nocino style modifier.

name: Tempus Fugit Crème de Noyaux
description: A classic style creme de noyaux from Tempus Fugit, pink and almond like from apricot kernels. Built for Pink Squirrels and pre Prohibition recipes.
image_query: Tempus Fugit Creme de Noyaux bottle

name: Luxardo Angioletto Hazelnut Liqueur
description: Hazelnut liqueur from Luxardo. Toasted nut sweetness as an Italian alternative to Frangelico in coffee and dessert drinks.

name: Chambord
description: French black raspberry liqueur from the Loire, with cognac and Madagascar vanilla. Rich berry for French Martinis and Champagne cocktails.

name: Cherry Heering
description: Danish cherry liqueur aged in wood, less sweet than cheap cherry brandy. Deep cherry for the Singapore Sling and Blood and Sand.

name: Marie Brizard Apry
description: Marie Brizard's apricot liqueur, long a bartender standard. Ripe apricot sweetness for classic and modern cocktails calling for apricot brandy.

name: Rothman & Winter Orchard Apricot
description: Austrian apricot liqueur from ripe orchard fruit. Fresh stone fruit rather than candy, favoured in craft cocktail bars.
image_query: Rothman and Winter Orchard Apricot bottle

name: Giffard Abricot du Roussillon
description: French apricot liqueur from Roussillon fruit by Giffard. Bright, ripe apricot for sours and stirred drinks.

name: Marionette Apricot Liqueur
description: Australian apricot liqueur from Marionette. Soft stone fruit for local bars substituting European apricot brandies.

name: Merlet Apricot Liqueur
description: French apricot liqueur from Merlet. Clean apricot fruit for cocktails calling for apricot brandy or liqueur.

name: Joseph Cartron Apricot Brandy
description: Burgundy apricot liqueur labelled apricot brandy. Ripe apricot for classics that specify the old apricot brandy call.

name: Merlet Crème de Pêche
description: French white peach creme from Merlet. Soft peach for spritzes, Bellini style drinks and peach sours.

name: Archers Peach Schnapps
description: British peach schnapps, a pub and home bar staple. Sweet peach for Fuzzy Navels, Woo Woos and simple mixed drinks.

name: De Kuyper Peachtree Schnapps
description: Widely distributed peach schnapps from De Kuyper. Bright candy peach for high volume peach cocktails.

name: Rinquinquin à la Pêche
description: Provencal peach aperitif wine from Distilleries et Domaines de Provence. Light, peachy and lower in sugar than schnapps, for spritzes.

name: Giffard Banane du Brésil
description: French banana liqueur from Giffard using Brazilian bananas. Ripe banana aroma for tiki drinks and banana Daiquiris.

name: Bols Banana Liqueur
description: Dutch banana liqueur from Bols. Sweet ripe banana for dessert cocktails and tropical mixed drinks.

name: Pisang Ambon
description: Bright green Dutch banana liqueur with Asian herb notes. Sweet banana for colourful shots and tropical cocktails.

name: Midori Melon Liqueur
description: Japanese honeydew melon liqueur, vivid green and sweet. The standard melon liqueur for Midori Sours and Japanese Slippers.

name: Giffard Crème de Cassis
description: Blackcurrant creme from Giffard in Angers. Rich cassis for Kirs and as a berry modifier in cocktails.

name: Lejay Crème de Cassis de Dijon
description: Dijon blackcurrant creme, from the house often credited with popularising cassis. Deep berry for Kir Royale and French aperitifs.

name: Briottet Crème de Cassis
description: Burgundy creme de cassis from Edmond Briottet. Intense blackcurrant used by bars that stock the Briottet fruit range.

name: Giffard Crème de Mûre
description: French blackberry creme from Giffard. Ripe blackberry fruit for Brambles, spritzes and berry cocktails.

name: Marionette Mûre
description: Australian blackberry liqueur from Marionette. Dark berry sweetness for Bramble style drinks.

name: Passoã
description: Passion fruit liqueur with a bright red colour, widely used in Pornstar Martinis. Tangy tropical fruit over a sweet base.

name: Chinola Passion Fruit Liqueur
description: Dominican passion fruit liqueur made with local fruit. Fresher and less candy like than many passion fruit liqueurs.

name: Malibu
description: Caribbean coconut rum liqueur, clear and sweet. Soft coconut for Pinacoladas, simple rum highballs and beach style mixed drinks.

name: Pallini Limoncello
description: Roman limoncello from Sorrento lemon peels. Bright sweet lemon, served ice cold as a digestif or in lemon cocktails.

name: Villa Massa Limoncello
description: Limoncello from Massa Lubrense on the Sorrento peninsula. Classic sweet lemon peel style for digestif service.

name: Pavan Muscat Liqueur
description: French Muscat grape liqueur with orange blossom. Soft floral grape for spritzes and light aperitif cocktails.

name: Granada Vallet
description: Mexican pomegranate liqueur from Vallet in Cordoba. Tart red fruit for Margaritas and agave cocktails.

name: Choya Umeshu
description: Widely exported Japanese umeshu from Choya. Soft plum and almond notes, drunk on ice, with soda or in highballs.

name: Giffard Crème de Violette
description: French violet liqueur from Giffard. Floral and purple, used when a Creme de Violette call is needed for Aviations.

name: Rothman & Winter Crème de Violette
description: Austrian violet liqueur from Rothman and Winter. Soft floral character favoured by craft bars for the Aviation.
image_query: Rothman and Winter Creme de Violette bottle

name: Tempus Fugit Crème de Violette
description: Violet liqueur from Tempus Fugit in a classic French creme style. Floral and lightly sweet for Aviation and Blue Moon cocktails.
image_query: Tempus Fugit Creme de Violette bottle

name: Giffard Pamplemousse Liqueur
description: French pink grapefruit liqueur from Giffard. Bittersweet grapefruit for spritzes, Palomas style drinks and gin cocktails.

name: Combier Rouge
description: A red cherry liqueur from Combier. Bright cherry fruit as a French alternative to cherry brandy in classics.

name: Tempus Fugit Crème de Cacao
description: Dark cacao liqueur from Tempus Fugit, less sweet than many cremes. Deep chocolate for Alexanders and dessert cocktails.
image_query: Tempus Fugit Creme de Cacao bottle

name: Giffard White Crème de Cacao
description: Clear cacao liqueur from Giffard. Clean chocolate without colour, for White Russians variations and dessert drinks.
image_query: Giffard white creme de cacao bottle

name: Marie Brizard White Crème de Cacao
description: Clear creme de cacao from Marie Brizard. Soft chocolate sweetness for classic dessert cocktails.
image_query: Marie Brizard white creme de cacao bottle

name: Tempus Fugit Crème de Menthe
description: White creme de menthe from Tempus Fugit, modelled on older French recipes. Clean peppermint for Stingers and Grasshoppers.
image_query: Tempus Fugit Creme de Menthe bottle

name: Giffard Menthe Pastille
description: Clear mint liqueur from Giffard, based on the French menthe pastille style. Bright peppermint for mint cocktails and dessert drinks.

name: De Kuyper Crème de Menthe Green
description: Green mint liqueur from De Kuyper. Sweet peppermint for Grasshoppers and colourful mint mixed drinks.
image_query: De Kuyper green creme de menthe bottle

name: Domaine de Canton Ginger Liqueur
description: French ginger liqueur with cognac, Provençal honey and vanilla. Spicy fresh ginger for mules, highballs and whiskey drinks.

name: The King's Ginger
description: English ginger liqueur originally made for King Edward VII. Hot ginger and lemon zest, for toddies, highballs and whiskey cocktails.

name: Ancho Reyes
description: Mexican ancho chile liqueur from Puebla. Dried chile, raisin and spice for Margaritas and stirred agave cocktails.

name: Ancho Reyes Verde
description: Green chile liqueur from the Ancho Reyes producers. Fresher, herbal heat compared with the original ancho expression.

name: John D. Taylor's Velvet Falernum
description: Barbadian falernum with lime, almond and clove on a rum base. The standard bottled falernum for Corn n Oil and tiki drinks.

name: The Bitter Truth Golden Falernum
description: German bottled falernum from The Bitter Truth. Spiced lime and almond for tiki builds when Velvet Falernum is unavailable.

name: St. Elizabeth Allspice Dram
description: Jamaican allspice dram from St. Elizabeth, on a rum base. Baking spice warmth for tiki drinks and stirred whiskey cocktails.

name: Nixta Licor de Elote
description: Mexican corn liqueur from Destileria y Bodega Legado, made with cacahuazintle maize. Sweet roasted corn for Margaritas and modern cocktails.

name: Fireball Cinnamon Whisky
description: Canadian whisky flavoured with intense cinnamon candy heat. Sweet and spicy, mostly taken as shots or in simple mixed drinks.

name: Southern Comfort
description: American whiskey flavoured liqueur with fruit and spice. Soft, sweet and peach tinged, for simple mixed drinks and Southern Comfort sours.

name: Pimm's No. 1
description: English gin based fruit cup with spices and caramel colour. The base of a Pimm's Cup with lemonade and fruit, a British summer staple.

name: Goldschläger
description: Swiss cinnamon schnapps with visible gold leaf flakes. Hot cinnamon sweetness, mostly served as a shot.

name: Bärenjäger Honey Liqueur
description: German honey liqueur with a vodka base and real honey. Soft honey sweetness for bees knees style drinks and hot toddies.

name: Irish Mist
description: Irish whiskey liqueur with honey and aromatic spirits. Soft honey and spice for after dinner pours and Irish coffee variations.

name: Tuaca
description: Italian brandy based liqueur with vanilla and citrus. Soft vanilla orange character for coffee drinks and simple mixed serves.

name: Hpnotiq
description: American blue liqueur of vodka, cognac and tropical fruit juices. Sweet and fruity, mostly for colourful mixed drinks.

name: Marie Brizard Parfait Amour
description: French violet and citrus liqueur, purple and floral. Used in classic parfait amour cocktails and as a violet accent.

name: Warninks Advocaat
description: Dutch egg liqueur, thick and custard like, the common UK advocaat brand. The usual pour for a Snowball with lemonade.

name: Bols Advocaat
description: Dutch advocaat from Bols, made with egg yolks and brandy. Custard sweetness for dessert drinks and Snowballs.

name: Mozart Chocolate Liqueur
description: Austrian chocolate liqueur from Mozart Distillerie in Salzburg. Rich cocoa for dessert cocktails and chocolate Martinis.

name: Godiva Chocolate Liqueur
description: Belgian style chocolate liqueur from the Godiva brand. Soft chocolate for dessert cocktails and cream based drinks.

name: Roots Mastiha
description: Greek mastiha liqueur from Chios mastic resin. Piney sweetness for Mediterranean cocktails and chilled digestif serves.

name: Giffard Caribbean Pineapple
description: French pineapple liqueur from Giffard. Ripe pineapple fruit for tiki drinks, punches and tropical sours.

name: De Kuyper Triple Sec
description: Widely available Dutch triple sec for high volume bars. Sweet orange at a lower price point than premium orange liqueurs.

name: Bols Triple Sec
description: Dutch triple sec from Bols. Sweet orange peel for Margaritas and other orange liqueur calls when a well pour is fine.

name: Briottet Crème de Violette
description: Burgundy violet creme from Edmond Briottet. Floral purple liqueur for Aviations and other violet classics.

name: Briottet Manzana Verde
description: Green apple liqueur from Briottet. Fresh apple sweetness for sours and modern fruit cocktails.

name: Walcher Nocino
description: Italian green walnut liqueur from the Walcher distillery in South Tyrol. Dark, bitter sweet walnut for digestifs and stirred drinks.

name: Giffard Crème de Framboise
description: French raspberry creme from Giffard. Bright raspberry for Champagne cocktails and berry sours.

name: De Kuyper Apricot Brandy
description: Widely available apricot brandy style liqueur from De Kuyper. Soft apricot for classics when a well pour apricot is enough.

name: Bols Apricot Brandy
description: Dutch apricot brandy style liqueur from Bols. Sweet apricot for Party cocktails and other apricot brandy calls.

name: Marie Brizard Crème de Menthe White
description: Clear mint creme from Marie Brizard. Clean peppermint for Stingers and white Grasshopper builds.
image_query: Marie Brizard white creme de menthe bottle

name: Marie Brizard Crème de Cassis
description: Blackcurrant creme from Marie Brizard. Soft cassis sweetness for Kirs, Kir Royales and berry cocktails.
image_query: Marie Brizard Creme de Cassis bottle

name: Luxardo Sangue Morlacco Cherry Liqueur
description: Luxardo cherry liqueur from marasca cherries, darker and fruitier than clear maraschino. Used in cherry cocktails and desserts.

name: Gabriel Boudier Crème de Cassis
description: Dijon creme de cassis from Gabriel Boudier. Classic Burgundy blackcurrant for Kir and Kir Royale.
image_query: Gabriel Boudier Creme de Cassis bottle

name: Giffard Vanille de Madagascar
description: French vanilla liqueur from Giffard with Madagascar vanilla. Soft vanilla for dessert cocktails and as a sweetener modifier.

name: Sheridan's
description: Layered Irish cream and coffee chocolate liqueur in a dual chamber bottle. Sweet cream and coffee for after dinner pours.

name: Dooley's Toffee Cream Liqueur
description: German toffee cream liqueur on a vodka base. Soft caramel cream for dessert drinks and shots.

name: Vok Melon Liqueur
description: Australian well pour melon liqueur from Vok. Sweet honeydew style melon for high volume bars.

name: Vok Banana Liqueur
